testimonial.name: DARRYL HOPKINS
testimonial.quote:
Rapid Platform is a great communication system for us to track everything from the beginning of a job - in the contract stage - all the way through to the maintenance stage.

Before Rapid we were using detailed Excel spredsheets - I think a lot of people's file systems were probably in their inbox. Now it's compiled, it's easy to access, we can run reports on all that data. It's a whole different world for us now
